GLOBAL REACH | FY2018 - Q3 2026
G1-G6 | Structure: merchant geography; time: expansion to scale
[I] Bet: local relevance broadens the merchant and revenue base.
|
|-- Scale outside North America (NA)
|   |-- [R] Revenue share: 25.5% 2019 -> 31.7% 2025 (seed-only).
|   |-- [S] Merchant share: 45% 2022 -> nearly half in 2025.
|   |-- [R] NA: 63.8% of FY25 incremental revenue (seed-only).
|   `-- [R] Revenue geography follows merchants, not buyers or shipment destinations.
|
|-- Outperformance is uneven
|   |-- [R] FY25 EMEA +42.1%; 74% of international revenue added.
|   |-- [R] APAC +27.5%; Latin America +7.2%; FY25 revenue $104M (seed units).
|   |-- [X] Every international region outperforms NA.
|   |-- [S] Q3 2026 GMV: Europe +33%, NA +28%, constant currency.
|   `-- [I] FX amplifies growth; Europe's lead persists at constant currency.
|
|-- Localization and acquisition
|   |-- [S] 2018 translation improved lead conversion; no figure.
|   |-- [S] Outside-core merchants: 24% -> 29% in 2018-19.
|   |-- Localization -[assoc]-> international growth.
|   `-- [S] Translation, marketing and partner investment overlapped.
|
|-- Payments availability and monetization
|   |-- [S] Countries: 15 (2019), 22 (2022), 39 (2025), 40 (2026).
|   |-- [X] Payments expanded into "60 new countries" in 2025.
|   |-- Availability -[mech]-> payments revenue eligibility; adoption is still needed.
|   |-- Availability -[assoc]-> international GMV; timing mixed.
|   |-- [R] EMEA merchant adoption: 86% 2024 -> 83% 2025.
|   `-- [S] New European markets dilute global penetration initially.
|
|-- Cross-border selling: native tools plus partner ecosystem
|   |-- [S] GMV share: 15% Q3 2025 -> 16% Q1 2026.
|   |-- [S] US Pro launch: Q3 2023; Canada/UK expansion: Q2 2026.
|   |-- [X] Promised expansion beyond the US was delivered in 2024.
|   |-- [R] Global-E equity received as non-cash consideration, 2021.
|   |-- [I] Partner/competitor tension possible; conflict unproven.
|   `-- Native vs partner volume split -[untestable]-> attribution.
|
|-- Tariffs: 2025 stress test
|   |-- [S] US inbound/outbound: about half of cross-border GMV.
|   |-- [S] Managed Markets enhanced duty/tax handling in Q1 2025.
|   `-- [I] Steady demand cannot isolate tools' effects from merchant actions.
|
`-- Allocation and remaining runway
    |-- [S] International: 2018 priority; ~40% of marketing in 2025.
    |-- [S] Capital available in eight countries entering 2026.
    `-- [I] Regional returns unavailable; marketing share is not total spend share.
